images.nl: A portrait comic page with three stacked panels read from top to bottom. The top and bottom panels are small; the middle action panel is the largest. The black-haired woman wears the white shirt and navy skirt; the brown-haired man wears the grey jacket and black trousers. Top panel, wide shot: she stands on the left holding a red suitcase in her right hand; he stands one step to her right. A wet bench is behind him, tracks recede into dusk, and rain drips from the station shelter. Middle panel, medium shot including both people's hands and the suitcase: his right hand offers one brass key with a blue cord, and her left hand receives it. She keeps the suitcase in her right hand. Bottom panel, close-up: she smiles softly toward him off-panel to her right, holding the same key in her left hand near her chest. Both adults keep the same appearance and clothes across panels. Rain and warm station light remain consistent. No speech bubbles or lettering.
